subject: BrightEdge: Thank-you package — convert to donation / split credits
messages:
From: Kate Miller <kate.miller@brightedge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: BrightEdge: Thank-you package — convert to donation?

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again to the Redwood team for the case study interview last month — the byline came out great. We discussed the planned thank-you package (swag + small gift) internally, and procurement asked whether we could convert the physical swag into a charitable donation instead.

A few practical asks from our side:
- If we convert to a donation, can Redwood issue a donation receipt addressed to "BrightEdge Ltd" (UK entity) with VAT-friendly language for our records?
- Alternatively, if you prefer to issue e-gift cards / credits to our three advocates (names below), procurement can approve faster. Is it possible to split a single incentive into three credits?
- Procurement will need an invoice (or pro forma) they can attach to the PO. Billing contact is procurement@brightedge.com.

Our three advocates are: Sam Torres, Priya Desai, and Leo Martin.

Appreciate a quick run-through of options and any docs you need from procurement.

Best,
Kate
Kate Miller
Head of Customer Advocacy
BrightEdge
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Kate Miller <kate.miller@brightedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: BrightEdge: Thank-you package — convert to donation?

Hi Kate — thanks for the clear note, and really glad the case study landed well. We can absolutely support both paths; summary below so procurement has something concise to review.

Option A — Donation in BrightEdge's name (preferred by some customers):
- Redwood issues donation to a charity you select and provides a donation receipt addressed to "BrightEdge Ltd". We will include the donation receipt and our internal letterhead.
- Typical turnaround: 3 business days after confirmation. We will also send an invoice to procurement indicating the donation amount (for accounts payable reconciliation).

Option B — Split e-gift credits (fastest for advocates):
- We can issue three e-gift credits (one per advocate) or a single account credit split across the three contacts. Credits appear on your account and are non-transferable.
- Dollars per advocate are fine (we typically recommend parity so all advocates get the same USD/EUR amount).

Logistics/questions we need from procurement to proceed:
- Billing name and VAT number to show on invoice/donation receipt.
- Billing address for the invoice.
- If you still want any physical items shipped (some teams like a small card), confirm shipping address and customs ID for the recipients.

I've attached our current swag_manifest.csv to show what was originally planned (so procurement can see SKU list if they prefer donation instead). Marissa — tagging you to confirm the donation process + suggested amounts (we can do combined donation + token credits if that helps).

Let me know which option procurement prefers and I'll route to Finance for an invoice.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Kate Miller <kate.miller@brightedge.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 15:40:00 +0100
Subject: Re: BrightEdge: Thank-you package — convert to donation?

Hi Kate / Hannah,

We can do a hybrid that often works well for procurement/stewardship: donate the equivalent retail value of the swag to a charity of BrightEdge's choice, and issue a small e-gift credit to each advocate as a thank-you. Example we propose:
- Donation: €1,500 to "Code for Europe" (we will provide a receipt to BrightEdge Ltd).
- Credits: €50 e-gift credit to each advocate (Sam, Priya, Leo) OR account credits totaling €150 split across their emails.

Attached is the swag_manifest.csv (so procurement can see the original SKU values) and a draft invoice stub we can send to your AP team. If procurement needs the donation paid to a specific charity bank account, please provide beneficiary details and any required documentation (W9 / UK charity number, etc.).

If procurement prefers straight credits and no donation, we can issue a single invoice for the total credits and apply them to the account immediately upon receipt.

For customs: since we're not shipping anything if you select donation/credits, customs shouldn't be necessary. If you still want the physical thank-you card mailed, confirm recipient addresses.

Thanks — looping in Priya so finance can finalize the VAT language on the invoice.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Customer Advocacy Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: swag_manifest.csv (17 rows)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.inference>
To: Kate Miller <kate.miller@brightedge.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 14:25:00 +0100
Subject: Re: BrightEdge: Thank-you package — convert to donation?

Hi Kate — copying the final billing details below so procurement can move forward. Invoice and the customs stub (blank) are attached for your AP team.

Invoice details:
- Invoice: invoice_BrightEdge_20270303.pdf (attached)
- Amount: EUR 1,650 (includes €1,500 donation + €150 credits split)
- VAT: Zero-rated for charitable donation when we remit directly to a registered EU charity — we will include charity registration number on the donation receipt. If BrightEdge requires the invoice to include VAT, please provide your VAT number and we will re-issue with the appropriate VAT calculation.
- Billing name/address: BrightEdge Ltd, 42 Fleet Street, London, EC4Y 1AA
- Payment terms: Net 30 to Redwoods Inference Ltd (bank details on invoice).

AP contact we have on file: procurement@brightedge.com — please confirm if a PO number should be referenced on the invoice.

Attachments: invoice_BrightEdge_20270303.pdf, customs_declaration.pdf (blank template for shipping; not required if you proceed with donation/credits).

Once you confirm (a) donation beneficiary or (b) split-credit choice and PO number, we will issue the final donation receipt and mark the credits on your account. If helpful, we can also send a short DocuSign acknowledgement for procurement records: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/XYZ-987654

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
